jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems
jobs.description:
_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Join TICRA in a newly established role and plan, coordinate, and drive software releases and major external projects across technical, product, and commercial functions.

Create clarity and predictability in complex delivery

As Project and Release Manager, you will join TICRA's Engineering Excellence domain and report to the Domain Lead. TICRA

Since its establishment in 1971, TICRA has built a strong reputation for technical excellence and deep expertise in electromagnetic modeling and antenna engineering.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – build the future of heavy-lift cargo UAV
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software engineer looking for something different? Imagine developing software in the morning, testing it on real hardware in the afternoon, and eventually watching it take flight.

At Acodyne, you will work alongside engineers developing next-generation unmanned aircraft, applying your software engineering experience to challenges that extend far beyond the screen.

You will have the opportunity to work across the software stack, from embedded systems and flight control integration to simulation, telemetry, and ground-based applications. You'll join a small, ambitious team where your contributions will have a direct impact on the aircraft we build.

**Your Role

**As part of our growing engineering team, you will develop and integrate software for our high-speed, heavy-lift cargo UAVs and their supporting systems.

You will work closely with electronics, mechanical, and aerospace engineers to turn ideas into working solutions, taking software from development through simulation, hardware integration, and real-world flight testing.

We believe that reliable software starts with good engineering practices. Code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and reproducible builds are important parts of how we want to develop our systems.

**You Will

**

• Develop and maintain software for our aircraft and supporting systems.

• Work with embedded Linux platforms, flight computers, sensors, actuators, and communication systems.

• Integrate and extend existing flight control technologies such as ArduPilot or PX4.

• Develop tools for telemetry collection, monitoring, data analysis, and ground control.

• Build and maintain simulation environments and automated tests to validate software before flight.

• Contribute to reliable development workflows, continuous integration, testing, and release processes.

• Collaborate across engineering disciplines to integrate and troubleshoot software and hardware.

• Participate in prototype development, system integration, and flight test activities.

• Document software designs, interfaces, and test results to support future certification and compliance.

**About You

**We're looking for an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems and takes pride in building reliable, maintainable software.

You've worked in a professional software development environment and understand the value of good engineering practices. Version control, code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and reproducible builds are a natural part of how you work.

You're comfortable taking ownership, making pragmatic engineering decisions, and collaborating with people from different technical backgrounds. You enjoy learning new technologies and aren't afraid to venture beyond your existing expertise.

You don't need to be an aerospace expert. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, technical curiosity, and the ability to master new domains.

**You Likely Have

**

• Several years of professional software development experience.

• Strong programming skills in C/C++ and experience developing software for Linux.

• Experience working with modern development workflows, including Git, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• An understanding of software architecture, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

• Some experience with embedded systems, hardware interfaces, or resource-constrained environments.

• A pragmatic, hands-on approach to engineering and an interest in working with physical systems.

• The ability to work independently while contributing constructively to a multidisciplinary team.

**It Would Be a Plus If You Have

**

• Experience with robotics, UAVs, autonomous systems, or flight control software.

• Familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4, MAVLink, or similar technologies.

• Experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or real-time systems.

• Knowledge of networking, telemetry, data acquisition, or distributed systems.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools or working with machine learning technologies.

We don't expect you to tick every box. We're more interested in your engineering mindset, technical curiosity, and ability to learn.

As an early-stage startup pushing the boundaries of innovation, we offer a salary typical for our phase of growth.

**About Acodyne

**Acodyne is on a mission to develop the world's fastest unmanned eVTOL aircraft for heavy payloads, initially to serve off-shore, remote areas and general logistics.

Beyond developing the aircraft, we're exploring how intelligent software, automation, and data-driven systems can shape the future of unmanned cargo operations.

We are a small, ambitious engineering team with plans to grow significantly. We're based at Avedøre Airfield, where your daily work will primarily take place.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously.

Please note that we are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

**Help us bring AI from ambition to reality

**At AGC Biologics, we have reached an exciting point in our AI journey. The governance foundation is in place, several high-value use cases have been identified, and we are now ready to scale the development and deployment of AI solutions across the business.

To support this journey, we are looking for an AI & Data Solutions Engineer who can help turn business challenges into practical and scalable AI solutions.

This role sits within our Global Data, AI & Business Platforms organization and will work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation. You will collaborate with stakeholders across AGC Biologics, partner with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, and contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In your first months, you will be involved in several AI initiatives already identified across the organization. Some solutions will be developed together with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, while others will be built and deployed directly within AGC Biologics.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys moving between business discussions and technical implementation. One day you may be meeting with stakeholders to understand a new AI opportunity and define requirements. The next, you may be preparing datasets, working on solution architecture, developing machine learning capabilities, or supporting the deployment of an AI solution into production.

You will work closely with our Data Engineering, Analytics, Solution Architecture, and Digitalization teams and play an important role in ensuring that AI solutions are technically robust, business-relevant, and ready for real-world use.

**What We're Looking For

**We imagine you come from a background in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field, and have already worked hands-on with building, deploying, or supporting AI and data-driven solutions.

You are comfortable working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Azure, and ideally have exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake. Experience working with machine learning models, AI applications, data pipelines, and data preparation is important, while familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or other emerging AI technologies would be a significant advantage.

Equally important is your ability to work with people. This is a highly business-facing role, and we are looking for someone who can confidently engage stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex concepts in a simple and understandable way.

You enjoy collaboration, challenge assumptions constructively, and thrive in environments where priorities evolve and new opportunities emerge.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed

**Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, or other GxP-regulated industries will be considered a strong advantage. We also welcome candidates coming from manufacturing or production-focused environments where technology, data, and business operations come together to support critical processes.

Whether your background is in AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering, what matters most is your ability to combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement and a genuine passion for solving business problems through technology.

**Why AGC Biologics?

**This is an opportunity to join a growing global team where AI is becoming a strategic capability across the organization. You will have the chance to influence how AI is adopted, work with modern technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and North America, and contribute to solutions that support the development and manufacturing of therapies that improve patients' lives around the world.

If you are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of AI at AGC Biologics, we would love to hear from you.

**Interested in Joining Us?

**If you are interested we would like to hear from you.

Applications are screened on an ongoing basis. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences in you CV about your motivation for applying to this position.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark, or the greater Malmø area.

If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. The right mindset matters just as much.

Please submit your application through the AGC Biologics careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer - Revenue Enablement Group
jobs.description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

**What You Will Do

**

• Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.

• Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.

• Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.

• A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to contribute meaningfully.

_Hybrid, Copenhagen based - report to SVP Growth

_**About The Role

**OrderYOYO builds the ordering apps and websites that thousands of restaurants across seven European markets use to take orders directly from their own customers. Our Growth team has one number to move: average orders per day per restaurant partner.

We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to find where those orders are being lost, design the experiments that win them back, and prove it with data — across the end-user apps (iOS and Android), the restaurant partner websites, and the marketing stack.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the SQL, build the test, read the result, and present it to the people who decide what ships next — working alongside a developer, a marketing manager, a paid media manager, and a data engineer.

**Role Mission

**Grow average orders per day per restaurant partner by finding where orders are lost across apps, websites and marketing channels, running the experiments that win them back, and making the Growth numbers trustworthy enough to decide on.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Own the end-user funnel view — from visit to order to repeat order — across apps and RP websites, by country and by restaurant partner.

• Run cohort, funnel, and retention analyses to find the biggest leaks in traffic, conversion, and repeat ordering, and size what fixing each one is worth in orders per day.

• Turn findings into a ranked backlog of hypotheses with expected impact and effort, and defend the ranking with the Growth team and Product.

• Design A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, success metric, guardrails, sample size and runtime, randomisation unit, and a pre-registered analysis plan — and set them up yourself on the apps and RP websites, working with the developer on feature flags or variant logic where code changes are needed.

• Check tests while they run (sample ratio, instrumentation, novelty effects) and read them out honestly, including when the result is flat or negative.

• Bring the same discipline to the marketing stack — paid media (Google Ads, Meta), email and push, SMS, landing pages, and restaurant partners' Google Business Profiles — using geo or restaurant-level splits and holdouts where a user-level test isn't possible, and judging traffic quality and incrementality on orders, not clicks.

• Own the definitions of the Growth metrics (AOD, conversion rate, new vs returning, retention), keep them consistent between GA4, the apps, and the warehouse, and chase tracking gaps with the data engineer and developer until fixes are verified with data.

• Partner with Algirdas on the Growth dashboards in Fabric and Power BI so reporting is automated rather than produced by hand.

• Build and own the experimentation playbook, and use AI as a daily tool — for SQL, analysis plans, and readouts — helping the team build small, repeatable AI workflows such as pre-test power calculations or weekly funnel checks. Experimentation is too important to be guesswork.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• 3 to 5 years in product, growth, or marketing analytics, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, e-commerce, or food ordering business.

• Strong SQL — able to write and debug multi-step queries over event and transaction data without help.

• A track record of designing, running, and reading A/B tests, with the statistics to do it properly: power and sample size, significance, guardrail metrics, and the common ways a test lies (peeking, sample ratio mismatch, novelty).

• Technical enough to set up a test yourself: comfortable with feature flags or an experimentation tool, basic JavaScript or app event instrumentation, and reading a tracking plan.

• Hands-on with a product or web analytics stack (GA4 or similar) and a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Comfortable testing in marketing channels as well as in product: campaign experiments in Google Ads or Meta, email or push tests, and geo or holdout designs for measuring incrementality.

• Uses AI tools daily for analysis work and can show how it changed the way you work.

• Clear, confident communication — able to take a messy result and explain to a non-technical audience what it means and what to do next, in writing and in person.

• Owns outcomes, not tasks, and is comfortable setting the plan in a small team rather than waiting for one.

• Fluent English. Danish is not required.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Python or R for statistical analysis and automating recurring checks.

• Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or another lakehouse and BI setup.

• Mobile app experimentation (Firebase, Optimizely, GrowthBook, Statsig, or similar) and web experimentation on multi-tenant or white-label sites.

• Sequential or Bayesian test methods, or quasi-experiments where a true A/B test isn't possible (for example, market-level or restaurant-level rollouts).

• Paid media data (Google Ads, Meta) and attribution, to judge traffic quality as well as conversion.

• A customer data platform and B2C engagement tooling (Segment, Braze, Firebase messaging, or similar), including running lifecycle tests in them.

• Building AI-assisted workflows or agents for analysis, not only using chat tools.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK59,000/ month

• A hybrid role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the analysis and experiments you run.

• The opportunity to directly move a revenue-critical metric: orders per day.

• A strong focus on data quality, honest experimentation, and analytics best practices.

• A collaborative, international Growth team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

This PhD project is part of a new Independent Research Fund project Smooth Tileable Surfaces. Joining the section for Mathematics at DTU Compute, you will help to develop the mathematical theory of a new class of surfaces in geometry, that are characterized as being decomposable into many copies of a small number of so-called prototiles. 

The subject has links to several areas of mathematics, including differential geometry and topology, graph theory and tiling theory, as well as applications in architecture and fabrication. 

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your focus is to help develop the new subject of smooth tileable surfaces by a) classifying generic subclasses of these surfaces b) establishing an understanding of their relations with graph theory and polyhedral theory, and c) developing methods for geometrically controlled generation of many examples of these surfaces. The overall project also involves collaboration with other team members, working towards the goal of developing not only the mathematical theory of these surfaces, but also algorithms for utilizing them in practical applications in architecture and fabrication.

You must have a background that includes a substantial amount of experience in mathematics, including:

• at least elementary differential geometry, 
• knowledge of, and interest in, some or all of the following subject areas: geometry of surfaces, topology, computational geometry, graph theory, group theory.
A genuine interest in the interplay between theoretical mathematics and applications is also essential.

During the 3 year programme you will:

• Investigate and prove theoretical properties of tileable surfaces
• Develop methods for controlled generation of these surfaces
• Collaborate with other team members on the scientific aspects of the project
• Publish articles in high quality scientific journals
• Present results at scientific conferences
• Contribute to teaching and co-supervision of BsC and MSc students
• Pass approximately 30 ECTS points of relevant coursework
You must have a two-year master's degree in mathematics (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of candidates will be ongoing until the position is filled, and applications received by 15 December are guaranteed full consideration. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

At DTU Compute, we have a large focus on creating a good working environment. Our work with diversity and inclusion is an essential part of that. We believe that having a good working environment is a necessary foundation to provide excellent research, teaching, supervision and innovation.

At DTU Compute, we have about 140 PhD students. We offer several events and activities for all our PhD students such as annual PhD Bazaar, onboarding course where you will meet other PhD students, and you can join our PhD Club that organizes BBQs, board games events, lunches etc. 

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk. 

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The expected starting date is 1 March 2027 with some flexibility. The position is a full-time position.

You can read about the project here: https://people.compute.dtu.dk/dbra/TileableProject.html and about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk.

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Senior Software Engineer – (Configuration and programming language design)

Join Us in Challenging the Life & Pension Sector.

Do you love programming language design, sophisticated verification logic and engineering solutions from start to finish? Festina Finance is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to evolve our configuration solutions, enabling business specialists to define and change the behaviour of the Festina Life and Pension platform.

Our Life & Pension solutions power the biggest pension funds in Denmark and the Netherlands and more than 30 banks across Scandinavia and the UK. As part of our fast‑growing and ambitious organization, you will help shape the core of systems used across Europe while working in a flat, informal culture with plenty of autonomy and room to influence.

What You Will Join

Festina Finance builds modern, high‑performance software platforms for the financial sector. You will join a team of highly skilled developers, actuaries, and domain specialists who work closely together to deliver solutions that are both technically strong and deeply rooted in business logic.

We value craftsmanship, curiosity, and collaboration. You will experience a workplace where people take responsibility, share knowledge, and enjoy solving hard problems together while having fun as a team.

Why this role is exciting

This role gives you the opportunity to work with a highly specialized and industry‑defining product that pushes the boundaries of what is possible in the pension sector. You will operate close to the core of our platform, where programming language design, verification and advanced business logic meet modern software engineering.

The products you will design are at the basis of all calculations and provide the definition of the business in the Festina Life and Pension platform. Scalability, performance, and proper design are key. Here you will get to work in the intersection between programing language design, systems architecture and direct contact with the people who depend on the result. You can expect your solutions to be in use for many years to come.

We produce solutions as a team and frequently have whiteboard sessions discussing upcoming designs and development changes. You can expect to learn through a mixture of individual work and team-based iteration.

What you will work on

Your work will span four main areas:

• Language, semantics and verification: Extend the syntax and semantics of F+, our own in-house functional programming language for financial domains. Design and strengthen the verification logic that ensures configuration is correct before it ever reaches production.

• Systems and architecture: Evolve our purpose-built version control system for F+. You will work with database design, API design, caching strategies, concurrency models, and performance.

• Tooling and operations: Build the configuration tools our business specialists rely on, including applications and integrations, and maintain the CI pipelines and production environment behind them — including monitoring and continuous cluster operations.

• Domain and customers: Analyze business domains, translate them into working solutions, and handle complex customer issues through direct contact with the people using what you build.

Needed skills

To thrive in this role, you should bring strong engineering fundamentals and a mindset suited for mission‑critical systems:

• Strong software engineering fundamentals

• A verification-driven mindset you enjoy building robust validation and verification

• Ability to take an idea from design to implementation while owning responsibility

• Experience designing large‑scale solutions for customers with active production systems

• A highly critical and detail‑oriented mindset our solutions sit at the core of all product calculations

• Strong collaboration skills we communicate intensively when exploring new design spaces

• A master’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

**The opportunity

**At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

**We Are Proud Of

**

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The Role

**Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

**Role Responsibilities

**

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

**What We Expect Of You

**

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

**Must Have Qualifications

**

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

**We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

**The Benefits

**This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

**

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

**Your application process

**Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

**About Valtech

**Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a new Platform Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating our cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Platform team, working primarily with Azure, AWS. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that everyone thinks about automation and scalability first.

Your Role & Impact

We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We already have a solid Kubernetes based platform used across the Enterprise. Now we need someone to come and help expand it, help our colleagues using and help in the other areas of Egmonts platform engineering

You will be doing hands-on work on our cloud platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

- Operate, develop and build on our Kubernetes platform

- Automating daily work around the cloud platforms we manage

- Develop and maintain tooling (GitHub Actions, Helm, Policies, etc)

- Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring – We use Datadog

- Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standards

- Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

- Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

- Experience from previous platform engineering or DevOps roles

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (Either is fine)

- Scripting or programming skills in any popular language, we use Go

- Experience with IaC tools, any apply, but we use Terraform

- Experience using ArgoCD

- Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

- Previously worked with open source and CNCF projects

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s building a hosting platform, which is easy to use for our developers.

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1148 Copenhagen K, Denmark

Application deadline: December 18 , 2026

Interviews: Will be scheduled periodically.

Please send your application as soon as possible - we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English. To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Rasmus Jørgensen (Manager, Cloud Platforms) at rasmusbo.jorgensen@egmont.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr IT and automation engineer, you will keep the systems behind our manufacturing equipment stable, connected and compliant. You will work where automation, IT infrastructure and system validation meet, taking technical responsibility for IT/OT Equipment from design to handover and through its operational life. Your work helps our development pilot plants and production facilities run reliably, so medicines for clinical trials and market supply can reach the people who need them.

**What You’ll Bring

**You do not need to be an expert in every area. Our scope is broad, spanning server infrastructure, automation interfaces, compliance and project delivery. If you have a solid foundation in IT or OT infrastructure, a proactive problem-solving mindset and the curiosity to grow into the rest, we encourage you to apply.

• A relevant degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT or a similar technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Solid experience with IT/OT infrastructure and equipment, automation or industrial IT.

• A good understanding of servers, operating systems, networks and industrial connectivity.

• A structured approach to troubleshooting and solving complex technical problems.

• The ability to independently drive technical tasks and deliverables in projects.

• Strong collaboration skills and fluency in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with SCADA/HMI, PLC communication, OPC UA or industrial Ethernet.

• Experience with GxP, GAMP 5, Data Integrity or system validation.

• Experience with virtualisation, industrial networking, firewall zoning or cybersecurity.

• Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash or other forms of automation.

• Experience with technical deliverables in engineering or investment projects.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the technical owner of the IT/OT foundation that manufacturing equipment depends on, handling day-to-day operations and driving projects forward.

• Deploy, configure, patch and maintain servers, Industrial PCs, operating systems and supporting infrastructure, and keep SCADA/HMI platforms and the communication between servers, PLCs and other plant-floor systems running.

• Take technical responsibility for the IT/OT components of manufacturing equipment throughout their lifecycle, planning and executing infrastructure and software upgrades and managing hardware and operating system End-of-Life.

• Drive IT/OT deliverables in equipment and facility projects, from technical scoping and design through commissioning and handover.

• Drive technical validation activities, keep Computerised Equipment in a validated state, maintain lifecycle documentation and support change controls in line with GxP and Data Integrity requirements.

• Perform technical IT Risk Assessments and support patching, access management, firewall reviews and network segmentation.

• Lead technical investigations and recovery of complex IT/OT incidents, infrastructure failures and communication issues, take part in the rotating on-call scheme for critical manufacturing infrastructure, and use scripting, automation and AI-assisted tools to simplify recurring tasks.

**Who You’ll Work With

**In Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC), we translate groundbreaking research into medicines for clinical trials and market supply worldwide. You will join CMC IT Operations & Digitalisation, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply, where we provide the reliable, compliant and secure IT/OT foundation for IT/OT Equipment across our development pilot plants and production facilities.

Day to day, you will work closely with automation engineers, equipment owners, project managers and central IT functions. You will also support international projects and sister sites in the Czech Republic and the US, so you can expect 10–20 days of travel per year. Clear priorities and honest, timely communication between these groups help you resolve issues quickly and keep projects moving.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to work independently and take ownership of your technical area, with colleagues who value practical engineering curiosity as much as experience. The role spans operations, validation, cybersecurity and projects, giving you room to build new skills across the value chain and grow with your colleagues on the job. You will also be encouraged to use AI-assisted tools to improve how the work gets done.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 DKK – 956,900 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy **here

****Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to keep critical manufacturing systems stable, compliant and moving forward, apply for the Senior IT/OT Operations Professional role by 1st December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Hiring Manager Asger Cederberg at **OYHA@novonordisk.com

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
